name: Mesa PanVK
author: abhay-byte
description: PanVK, the Mesa Vulkan driver for Arm Mali GPUs, on the mali_kbase kernel driver: Bifrost JM v6/v7, Valhall JM v9 and CSF v10-v14 in one universal .so, supporting v6 to v14. v15 (Mali-G2) is not fully supported. Mesa 26.3.0-devel development build (git-795ca7ff3e). Bundled in this APK.
build: 122i (final perf build, 0170 v9 BC per-texel, 0171/0173/0175 sw WSI readback per swapchain, 0172 v10+ cold BC, 0174 v12 incremental rendering): series csf-v11 018-233 + jm-v9 + jm-v7 + jm-v7-wip 0006-0175 (prepare-rc5-tree.sh defaults; p122g 795ca7ff3e)
